propositions: Test fixtures creating bare repositories fail under safe.bareRepository=explicit when bare repositories are targeted implicitly via cwd or git -C rather than explicit --git-dir
The root cause is that Git 2.55+ rejects implicit bare-repository discovery under explicit policy; the same commands succeed when the repository is explicitly selected with top-level --git-dir

Generic test helpers serving both worktrees and bare repositories cannot use a blanket conversion to --git-dir without breaking worktree semantics, requiring fixture-specific targeting at each confirmed call site

Production code in prepare_reclaim_backup.py::_verify_restore exhibits the same bare-repository targeting defect in its throwaway restore.git, masked by prior fixture setup failures until the fixture mechanism is repaired

The repair must use narrow bare-only helpers with explicit --git-dir at confirmed bare call sites while preserving generic -C behavior for worktrees, all safety pins, upkeep values, and fail-fast checks
